en.content:
Match the chemical substances in Column I with type of polymers/type of bonds in Column II. Indicate your answer by darkening the appropriate bubbles of the 4 4 matrix given in the ORS.

Column I Column II
(A) cellulose (P) natural polymer
(B) nylon-6, 6 (Q) synthetic polymer
(C) protein (R) amide linkage
(D) sucrose (S) glycoside linkage
en.explanation:
(A) Cellulose - a natural polymer of -D-glucose, linked by glycoside linkage.

(B) Nylon-6, 6 is a synthetic polymer of adipic acid and 1, 6-diaminohexane. The diacid is linked with diamine through amide linkage.

(C) Protein- a natural polymer of -amino acids where individual amino acid units are linked by amide linkage.

(D) Sucrose- has glycoside linkage, a disaccharide
